kind: # The seasons of the Roman calendar.  `rank_weekday` and `rank_sunday` place
# the season's ordinary days in the Table of Liturgical Days: the weekdays of
# Lent and of 17-24 December, and the days of the Christmas octave, are
# privileged (9), so an obligatory memorial on one becomes a commemoration.
# Label rows (a name, no season) name the ring; color rows (a season, no
# name) color the days.  See docs/traditions.md.
# The cycles, on the outer ring: the Christmas and Easter cycles, and the
# thirty-three or thirty-four weeks of Ordinary Time between and after them.
